text: “A month to master the technique. But before that…I require all the funds Lyonette will give me. I must meet with Wall Lord Ascoden and any who will hear me. It is not the optimal solution, but if it comes to it, I will be ready to break through Fissival’s walls. I will have my people and my promises kept.” Montressa’s breath caught in her throat, and she saw the Archmage of Izril turn back to the rain. It was a soft-spoken declaration of war from a woman who never saw the point in lying. Or showing mercy to her enemies. The future had given her a vision of what might be. So, Valeterisa prepared herself to do battle with the City of Incantations. She stared out the window and ran the first simulation of how to siege a city by spell. Just as Archmage Amerys had once done. She didn’t think of the little girl. Not right now. Nor the returned Valceif. She was too busy. The Archmage of Izril’s hands tightened on the windowsill. She was at war. A displeasing thing. A terrible waste of time. If it had to be— Valeterisa intended to win it. She thought of the dead clockmaker that Future Mrsha had seen on television and began to plot how to take Fissival to pieces. Brick by brick.
